name: Theatre curtain bookends

source.description: An inspected storybook piece opens and closes on stage curtains.

technique: Curtains part to open the story and close at the end, framing the piece as a performance and giving it a clear beginning and end.
purpose: Framing device for stories, poems and announcements.
visual_behaviour: Two drapes slide apart (with slight sway) over about 2 s; they close the same way at the end, with the music fading in and out with them.
mechanics: Two panels translating outward with ease-in-out; optional skew sway; fold texture.

decomposition.timing: About 2 s open (ref-910d9fc567 0-2.1 s), about 1-2 s close at the end.

failure_modes: Kitsch when the story is not theatrical

implementation.approach: Two absolutely positioned panels with a fold gradient; fromTo xPercent outward; reverse to close. Small enough to build when a brief asks for it.

provenance.observed: Red curtains open on the stage and close at the end.
